title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
synonyms: The Song That Transcends This World
synopsis: During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Ebichu Minds the House
titleNative: おるちゅばんエビちゅ
synopsis: Episodes follow Ebichu, a talking hamster devoted to her oft-indifferent owner, who is only identified as OL ("Office Lady"), a single 25-year-old (this is the age Japanese women are considered nearing the end of the ideal marrying age) who doles out cynical commentary and the occasional beating on the rodent. Ebichu tends to take this in stride with endless praise and compliments. Such abuse is usually caused by Ebichu's almost disturbing lack of tact or propriety, often embarrassing her master in front of other people. Ebichu often attempts to correct OL's bad decisions, such as her berating of OL's obnoxious and untrustworthy boyfriend Ebichu nicknamed Kaishounachi (literally, Useless).

title: Teto X Egen
synopsis: Ha-Seon, a “workaholic” for whom her company and job are her whole life, and Seon-Ho, a “homebody” whose world consists only of his home and his cat. These two seemed as unlikely to cross paths as parallel lines. But not only are they assigned to the same task force, it turns out they’re actually neighbors, and their daily lives begin to get tangled up. Just when things are getting complicated, Seon-Ho’s first love shows up…! What will become of this precarious yet strangely thrilling relationship between two people who lived in completely different worlds? (Source: Millie, translated)

A Relaxed Life of Gathering Materials in Another World
synopsis: The protagonist, Sozai Shu, a 26-year-old single man, is a gamer with a natural collecting habit. After losing his life in the joy of obtaining a rare material in a game, he is transported to another world by the power of God. In order to make life in the other world easier, Shu prays to God for the "power to gather materials at his own pace!" His wish is granted, but somehow the power is strangely strong and convenient!? In a different world full of unknown materials, Shu struggles to gather various materials in order to live a rich and relaxed life of gathering materials! (Source: Amazon Japan, translated)
